description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'ForbiddenController' within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The controller extends a base Vue controller and implements an interface to manage unauthorized access handling by setting a 'forbidden' component for rendering.

classes.name: ForbiddenController
classes.description: A controller responsible for handling forbidden (unauthorized) access pages, setting a specific Vue component for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component for the forbidden page by creating and assigning the 'auth-forbidden' component.
